# hyperfluid_agent_discord_channel (Resource)

The Discord channel of an agent: a bot on the Discord gateway, so no public endpoint is needed. It answers a mention or a reply that pings it (it does not request the privileged message content intent). Creating it sets the channel and lists `discord` in the agent's interfaces; destroying it removes both, and the agent stays. Every change sends the whole channel configuration again: an argument removed from the configuration returns to the platform's default. A channel removed outside Terraform leaves the state, and the next apply sets it again. The status attributes (`phase`, `identity`, `message`, `last_event_at`) are the gateway's and are refreshed on read without planning changes. The platform refuses a channel on a capability, and on an agent whose tools include general `hfctl` unless the agent sets `allow_platform_tools`. Imported by agent id. Needs the organization's `sapience_agent_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_secret" "discord_bot_token" {
  name = "discord-bot-token"
}

resource "hyperfluid_agent_discord_channel" "this" {
  agent_id            = hyperfluid_agent.support.id
  bot_token_secret_id = data.hyperfluid_secret.discord_bot_token.id
  allowed_guilds      = ["123456789012345678"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Id of the `hyperfluid_agent`. Changing this forces a new Discord channel.
- `allowed_guilds` (Set of String) Ids of the Discord servers (guilds) the bot serves, checked on every message; it leaves any other server it is added to.
- `bot_token_secret_id` (String) The Discord application's bot token. The id of a plaintext `hyperfluid_secret` of the organization: the value is never sent or stored by Terraform.

### Optional

- `allowed_channels` (Set of String) Channel ids the bot answers in. Left out, every channel of the allowed servers.
- `allowed_users` (Set of String) User ids the bot answers. Left out, every member of the allowed servers.
- `direct_messages` (Boolean) Whether the bot answers direct messages. Left out, the platform's default (off).

### Read-Only

- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the channel is active: its configuration is present and its interface listed on the agent.
- `id` (String) The agent id.
- `identity` (String) Who the bot is on the network, as the gateway reports it.
- `last_event_at` (String) When the gateway last saw an event, RFC 3339.
- `message` (String) The gateway's detail on the current phase.
- `phase` (String) The gateway's phase for this channel: `Connecting`, `Connected`, `NeedsLogin`, `Degraded` or `Disabled`. Empty until the operator has reported it. Refreshed on read, it never plans a change on its own.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import id is the agent id (uuid).
terraform import hyperfluid_agent_discord_channel.this 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
